functions.name: create_comm_channel
functions.description: Returns an identifier and a BindableEvent. Used in one-way communication between actors.

functions.name: get_comm_channel
functions.description: Returns a BindableEvent. Used in one-way communication between actors.

functions.name: getactors
functions.description: Returns a table of actors (not including deleted ones).
functions.example:
for _, actor in ipairs(getactors()) do
    print(actor.Name)
end
functions.notes: Some games delete their actors while they're running.

functions.name: getactorthreads
functions.description: Returns a table of every thread connected to every actor.

functions.name: getdeletedactors
functions.description: Returns a table of every deleted actor.

functions.name: is_parallel
functions.description: Returns a boolean indicating whether the current thread is running in parallel.
functions.example:
if is_parallel() then
    print('Running in parallel!')
end

functions.name: run_on_actor
functions.description: Executes a script on an actor.

functions.name: run_on_thread
functions.description: Executes a script on an actor thread.

functions.name: getfunctionhash
functions.description: Returns the hash of a lua function.

functions.name: hookfunction
functions.description: Hooks a Lua or C function. Returns a copy of the original function.
functions.notes: Always call the original to avoid breaking game logic.

functions.name: iscclosure
functions.description: Returns a boolean indicating whether the function is a C closure.

functions.name: isexecutorclosure
functions.description: Returns a boolean indicating whether the function has been created by the executor.

functions.name: isfunctionhooked
functions.description: Returns a boolean indicating whether the function has been hooked.

functions.name: islclosure
functions.description: Returns a boolean indicating whether the function is a lua closure.

functions.name: isnewcclosure
functions.description: Returns a boolean indicating whether the function has been created using newcclosure.

functions.name: loadstring
functions.description: Creates a chunk from the provided source code.
functions.example:
local func, err = loadstring('print("Hello")')
if func then func() end

functions.name: newcclosure
functions.description: Creates a new C closure for 'func'.
functions.example: local c_func = newcclosure(function() print('C closure') end)

functions.name: newlclosure
functions.description: Creates a new Lua closure for 'func'.

functions.name: restorefunction
functions.description: Restores a previously hooked Lua or C function to its original implementation.

functions.name: setstackhidden
functions.description: Hide a function from call-stack based detections.

functions.name: rconsoleclear
functions.description: Clears all text in the console.

functions.name: rconsolecreate
functions.description: Creates a console window.

functions.name: rconsoledestroy
functions.description: Destroys the console window.

functions.name: rconsoleerror
functions.description: Prints a red message to the console.
functions.notes: Creates console if not already created.

functions.name: rconsoleinfo
functions.description: Prints a dark blue message to the console.

functions.name: rconsoleinput
functions.description: Receives input directly from the console. Yields until input is received.

functions.name: rconsoleprint
functions.description: Prints to the console.

functions.name: rconsolesettitle
functions.description: Sets the title of the console window.

functions.name: rconsolewarn
functions.description: Prints a yellow message to the console.

functions.name: crypt.base64decode
functions.description: Returns a base64 decoded string.

functions.name: crypt.base64encode
functions.description: Returns a base64 encoded string.

functions.name: crypt.decrypt
functions.signature: crypt.decrypt(data: string, key: string, iv: string, mode: string?): string
functions.description: Decrypts provided data using AES encryption.

functions.name: crypt.encrypt
functions.signature: crypt.encrypt(data: string, key: string, iv: string?, mode: string?): (string, string)
functions.description: Encrypts provided data using AES encryption.

functions.name: crypt.generatebytes
functions.description: Returns a base64 encoded string of randomly generated bytes.

functions.name: crypt.generatekey
functions.description: Generates and returns a random key for encryption.

functions.name: crypt.hash
functions.description: Hashes data using the specified algorithm (sha256, sha1, md5, etc).

functions.name: crypt.hmac
functions.signature: crypt.hmac(data: string, key: string, algorithm: string): string
functions.description: Generates an HMAC (Hash-based Message Authentication Code).

functions.name: crypt.lz4compress
functions.description: Returns a compressed string using the LZ4 algorithm.

functions.name: crypt.lz4decompress
functions.description: Returns a decompressed string using the LZ4 algorithm.

functions.name: crypt.random
functions.description: Returns a string of randomly generated bytes. Not base64 encoded.

functions.name: debug.getcallstack
functions.description: Returns a table of the entire stack's information.

functions.name: debug.getconstant
functions.description: Returns a singular constant from a function.

functions.name: debug.getconstants
functions.description: Returns a table of all constants from a function.

functions.name: debug.getinfo
functions.description: Returns a table of information about a function or stack level.

functions.name: debug.getproto
functions.signature: debug.getproto(func: function, index: number, active: boolean?): function|table
functions.description: Gets a cloned proto inside the 'func'.

returns.description: Cloned proto or table of active protos

functions.name: debug.getprotos
functions.description: Returns a list of all cloned protos.

functions.name: debug.getregistry
functions.description: Returns the Lua registry table.

functions.name: debug.getupvalue
functions.description: Returns a singular upvalue from a function.

functions.name: debug.getupvalues
functions.description: Returns a table of upvalues from a function.

functions.name: debug.setconstant
functions.signature: debug.setconstant(func: function, index: number, value: any): void
functions.description: Sets a singular constant in a function.

functions.name: debug.setupvalue
functions.signature: debug.setupvalue(func: function, index: number, value: any): void
functions.description: Sets a singular upvalue in a function.

functions.name: debug.getstack
functions.description: Returns a table of the stack or a singular object from the stack.

returns.description: Stack array or specific stack value

functions.name: debug.setstack
functions.signature: debug.setstack(level: number, index: number, value: any): void
functions.description: Sets a singular object on the stack.

functions.name: getgenv
functions.description: Returns the global environment table.

functions.name: getrenv
functions.description: Returns the Roblox global environment table.

functions.name: getsenv
functions.description: Returns the script environment of a LocalScript or ModuleScript.

functions.name: getreg
functions.description: Returns the Lua registry.

functions.name: getgc
functions.description: Returns a table of objects from the garbage collection list.
functions.example:
for _, v in pairs(getgc(true)) do
    if type(v) == 'table' then
        -- do stuff
    end
end

functions.name: filtergc
functions.signature: filtergc(type: string, options: table, returnSingle: boolean?): table|any
functions.description: Returns a table of objects filtered from the garbage collection list.

functions.name: Drawing.new
functions.description: Create a new drawing object of the specified type.
functions.example:
local text = Drawing.new('Text')
text.Text = 'Hello'
text.Visible = true

functions.name: cleardrawcache
functions.description: Removes all rendered drawing objects from the cache.

functions.name: getrawmetatable
functions.description: Gets the metatable from an object whilst ignoring the __metatable value.

functions.name: setrawmetatable
functions.description: Sets the metatable for an object whilst ignoring the __metatable value.

functions.name: setreadonly
functions.description: Sets the table's read-only/protected status.

functions.name: hookmetamethod
functions.signature: hookmetamethod(obj: any, method: string, func: function): function
functions.description: Hooks a metamethod inside the object.

functions.name: getnamecallmethod
functions.description: Gets the current thread's __namecall method.
functions.notes: Must be called within a __namecall hook.

functions.name: readfile
functions.description: Read an existing file from the workspace directory.

functions.name: writefile
functions.description: Write a file to the workspace directory.

functions.name: request
functions.description: Creates a HTTP request with specified options.

functions.name: gethui
functions.description: Returns a container that's hidden from game scripts.

functions.name: fireclickdetector
functions.signature: fireclickdetector(detector: ClickDetector, distance: number?, event: string?): void
functions.description: Fires a ClickDetector's signal.

functions.name: setthreadidentity
functions.description: Sets the current thread's identity.

functions.name: getthreadidentity
functions.description: Returns the current thread's identity.

functions.name: cache.invalidate
functions.description: Removes an instance from the internal reference cache.

functions.name: cache.iscached
functions.description: Returns whether or not an instance exists within the reference cache.

functions.name: cache.replace
functions.description: Replaces an instance with another instance in the internal reference cache.

functions.name: cloneref
functions.description: Returns a clone of the Instance reference, bypassing == comparisons against the original.
functions.example:
local clone = cloneref(game)
print(clone == game) -- false

functions.name: compareinstances
functions.description: Compares two instance references to see if they point to the same underlying object.

returns.description: True if they reference the same object

functions.name: isourthread
functions.description: Returns a boolean indicating whether the current thread was created by Potassium.
functions.example: if isourthread() then print('Running on executor thread') end

functions.name: debug.getsafeenv
functions.description: Returns the safe environment flag of an object.

functions.name: debug.isvalidlevel
functions.description: Checks if the provided stack level integer is valid.

functions.name: debug.setinfo
functions.description: Modifies debug information associated with a function.

functions.name: debug.setname
functions.description: Changes the debug name of a function.

functions.name: debug.setsafeenv
functions.description: Sets the safe environment flag for a function or object.

functions.name: Drawing.Fonts
functions.description: Table containing font identifiers (UI, System, Plex, Monospace).

functions.name: getrenderproperty

functions.name: isrenderobj
functions.description: Returns a boolean indicating whether the provided value is a DrawingObject.

functions.name: setrenderproperty

functions.name: gettenv

functions.name: delfolder
functions.description: Deletes a directory at the specified workspace path.

functions.name: dofile
functions.description: Loads and executes a file from workspace as a Lua chunk.

functions.name: isfile
functions.description: Checks if a path in the workspace directory points to a file.
functions.example: if isfile('config.json') then print('Config exists') end

functions.name: isfolder
functions.description: Checks if a path in the workspace directory points to a folder.
functions.example: if isfolder('data') then print('Folder exists') end

functions.name: listfiles
functions.description: Returns an array of file and folder paths located inside the specified directory.
functions.example: for _, file in ipairs(listfiles('')) do print(file) end

functions.name: loadfile
functions.description: Compiles a file into a Lua chunk function without executing it.
functions.example:
local chunk, err = loadfile('lib.lua')
if chunk then chunk() end

functions.name: makefolder
functions.description: Creates a new folder at the specified path in the workspace directory.

functions.name: isrbxactive

functions.name: keytap
